en-US.title: Pocket Budget: Expense Tracker
en-US.short_description: Track spending, set budgets and see where your money goes each month.
en-US.full_description:
Pocket Budget helps you understand your spending in minutes a day.

Add expenses with one tap, scan receipts with the camera, and group them into categories that make sense to you. Set a monthly budget per category and get a gentle reminder before you overspend.

Features:
- Quick add with smart category suggestions
- Receipt scanning
- Monthly and yearly reports
- Shared budgets for couples and families
- Export to CSV

Your data stays on your device unless you turn on encrypted sync.
en-US.release_notes: Shared budgets now sync in real time. Receipt scanning is faster on older phones.
